events.description: Resets the kiosk: drops the session and the basket and shows the attract screen.
events.name: onIdle

props.description: How long, in milliseconds, without a touch, a key or a pointer before the kiosk resets (a device setting).
props.name: idleTimeoutMs

props.description: The reach layout; `standing` when left out.
props.name: reach

props.description: True to speak announcements aloud (audio guidance through the kiosk's speaker or headphone jack).
props.name: isAudioOn

props.description:
Speaks a text aloud in the kiosk's language. On web the browser's speech synthesis speaks when this is left out;
on native the caller passes the platform's speech, since React Native has none of its own.
props.name: speak
